In #38126, we want to use :caution: in an error message. But in this case, we also don't want to ban the version without the unicode emoji variant selector, ⚠, as this is what is used in lake output (which could conceivably be mentioned in a comment or module docstring somewhere).

What's the right change here? Do we need maybeEmojis := #['⚠'] and corresponding logic in the TextBased linter?
Also, I suspect so, but just to check: do these changes need to make it into master before #38126 passes CI? :eyes: EDIT: Nevermind, looks like it's fine to do on a non-master branch :)
I've created #39796 in case this is the right approach. :)
